description: This file defines the MyGLRenderer class for managing rendering in an OpenGL ES context, including setting up matrices, drawing shapes, and handling rendering lifecycle methods.

methods.name: onSurfaceCreated
methods.description: Initializes OpenGL settings and creates shape objects.

methods.name: onDrawFrame
methods.description: Clears buffers, sets camera, applies transformations, and draws shapes each frame.

methods.name: onSurfaceChanged
methods.description: Adjusts viewport and projection matrix on surface size changes.

methods.name: loadShader
methods.description: Compiles a shader of given type with provided shader code.

methods.name: checkGlError
methods.description: Checks for OpenGL errors during rendering calls.
